decisions.reason: The cleaning soap moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing visible commitment, and as a care accessory it fits the firm's established flooring business.

The maintenance oil is a low-cost complement to the core oiled-floor offer and is still mentioned on the website, but little has been invested publicly in it, so it is somewhat more exposed than the featured care products.
The care product for oiled floors now has a dedicated page, a visible public commitment that management would not want to reverse.
The moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory that supports floor system sales, and nothing suggests its results have disappointed, so there is no reason to drop it.
The high-density foam underlay carries little investment or public commitment, which leaves it somewhat at risk of being cut, but it complements the flooring systems at low cost.
The oak parquet sits at the centre of the firm's core business and production investment, so dropping it would be very unlikely.
